frozen: 12 Nov 2026, before the first run. Expected supported and contradicted verdicts come from the Copernicus observed maps near each place (NISAR new water was not looked at), using the approved thresholds with Copernicus flooded pixels in place of NISAR new water; places with a mapped share below 0.5, or where the two AOI01 maps disagree, were not used for them. Expected fields come from the text alone.
